info.title: MetaPlatform API
info.description: Unified OpenAPI spec merging all MetaPlatform app packages: copilot, a2a, arch, apphub, kb, and iam (dashboard / admin).

schema.title: Response Get Root Api V1 Copilot Get
Response Auth Login Api V1 Copilot Auth Login Post

post.description:
Proxy A2A delegation to mate-app-a2a (in-process for P2-W3).

Accepts {target_agent_id, message, context} and creates a
delegation task in the a2a repository. Returns the task_id +
pending status. Emits copilot.a2a.delegated outbox event.

schema.title: Response A2A Delegate Api V1 Copilot A2A Delegate Post

get.description:
Return the current authenticated user profile + roles.

Uses inline bearer parsing to avoid the `Depends(get_caller)` overhead and
sidestep an observed dep-resolution issue under uvicorn. Returns 401 when the
bearer token is missing or invalid; 404 when the token is valid but the user
no longer exists.
